name: Arctic Air Ultra 3-in-1 Mini USB Portable Air Cooler | Personal Evaporative AC with LED Night Light for Home Office Travel
description:
Beat the heat with the Arctic Air Ultra, a compact 3-in-1 mini air cooler that works as a personal AC, humidifier, and LED night light. Powered via USB, it uses advanced evaporative cooling to reduce surrounding temperatures by up to 6°C—without harmful chemicals. With 3 fan speeds, adjustable air vents, and a reusable filter, you can enjoy fresh, cool air wherever you are. Quiet, lightweight, and portable, it’s perfect for bedrooms, offices, or travel.

Key Features
3-in-1 function: Cooler, humidifier & night light
USB-powered design (not rechargeable)
3 adjustable fan speeds & air vents
7-color LED night light for ambience
Reusable & easy-to-clean filter
Compact, lightweight & travel-friendly

Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic body, reusable filter, electronic components

How to Use
Fill water tank with clean water
Connect via USB cable to power source
Adjust fan speed and vent direction
Switch LED light mode as desired

Package Includes
1 × Arctic Air Ultra Mini Cooler
1 × USB Power Cable
1 × User Manual
